Here all of Vabbi trades, mingles, and gossips." }} [[The Kodash Bazaar]] is the largest and most bustling of all the marketplaces in the whole of [[Vabbi]]. It is considered the center of trade for the merchant nation. ==Getting there== Characters will wind up here after completing [[Tihark Orchard]]. Alternatively, travel northeast from the [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard outpost]]. The quickest way to get here the first time is to finish the [[Moddok Crevice]] mission, then starting from [[Wehhan Terraces]] travel north via [[Yatendi Canyons]] and [[Vehtendi Valley]]. ==Exits==
